description: Reads a small business's website (the home page and up to 6 pages on the same site) and writes five social media posts for the week, Monday to Friday: a service spotlight, behind the scenes, a question answered, a tip and a gentle call to action. Each has a caption, 3 to 6 hashtags, an idea for a photo the owner can take, and the page it's based on. Gemini writes them from the site's text only, without web search; then OOO Works' checks drop any post with a number, offer, discount, price, award or other claim that isn't on its page, a quote or talk of reviews, or a link to another site. Posts can be shaped for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, X, Naver Blog or a KakaoTalk channel, in English or Korean. Nothing is posted; the owner reads and posts them. Limited to 5 runs a day per caller; the same site and choices are answered from memory for 24 hours.
